(2007, 2008, 2010) | tournaments = | tournament_list = }} '''Jarvis Varnado''' (born March 1, 1988 in [[Brownsville, Tennessee]]) is an American [[college basketball]] player for the [[Mississippi State Bulldogs men's basketball|Mississippi State Bulldogs]]. Varnado is known as a defensive specialist and is especially adept at shot blocking aided by his 7'4" wingspan. He led the NCAA in blocks for the 2007–08 season with 157 blocks which tied [[Shaquille O'Neal]] for the most blocks in a season in the SEC. In the 2008–09 season, he would shatter that single season record with 170 blocks. Varnado was named [[Southeastern Conference|SEC]] Defensive Player of the Year in 3 consecutive years (2008, 2009, and 2010) becoming the first person to ever do so. Collegeinsider.com named Varnado their National Defensive Player of the Year for 2008. On November 21, 2009, Jarvis Varnado became the SEC's all-time career block record holder with 413 total blocks in his career. This passed O'Neal's career block record of 412.[http://scores.espn.go.com/ncb/recap?gameId=293250344 Mississippi St. 67, Bethune-Cookman 51] On January 23, 2010, Varnado surpassed [[Adonal Foyle]] on the NCAA's all-time career blocks list to become the second-leading shot-blocker. Needing 8 blocks for the record, Varnado finally became the NCAA's all-time shot blocker against Alabama on February 24, 2010 passing Wojciech Myrda's record of 535 career blocks.http://www.commercialappeal.com/news/2010/feb/24/mississippi-states-varnado-sets-ncaa-shot-blocking/ Mississippi State's Varnado sets NCAA shot-blocking record Jarvis Varnado is now the only college player in history to achieve the 1,000/1,000/500 milestone (points/rebounds/blocks). ==References== {{Reflist}} ==External links== *http://secsports.com/new/sports/bkc/09stats/MS.HTM *http://www.mstateathletics.com/ViewArticle.dbml?SPSID=90867&SPID=10994&DB_OEM_ID=16800&ATCLID=944351&Q_SEASON=2008 *http://seattletimes.nwsource.com/html/huskies/2008870800_umen17.html?syndication=rss *http://www.collegeinsider.com/awards/defense_player_08.html {{NABC Defensive Player of the Year}} {{Lefty Driesell Award}} {{NCAA Division I men's basketball blocks champion}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Varnado, Jarvis}} [[Category:1988 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:African American basketball players]] [[Category:People from Haywood County, Tennessee]] [[Category:Mississippi State Bulldogs basketball players]] [[Category:Basketball players from Tennessee]] [[Category:Power forwards (basketball)]] {{1980s-US-basketball-bio-stub}}
